judgements.name: opencode-dynamic-context-pruning
reasons: Criterion 1 (warn): AGPL-3.0-or-later is OSI-approved copyleft and should be clearly disclosed to users.
Criterion 5 (info): no egress is declared, which is needed before network behavior can be verified.
judgements.user_note: This plugin is retained, but users should be informed it uses AGPL copyleft licensing and that network egress declarations are still missing.

judgements.name: opencode-conductor
reasons: Criterion 6 warning: package runs a postinstall script (`node scripts/postinstall.cjs`), so script contents should be reviewed before verification.
Criterion 5 info: no egress is declared, which is required before network behavior can be verified.
judgements.user_note: This entry can remain community-listed, but it should not be promoted to verified until egress is declared and the postinstall script is reviewed.

judgements.name: opencode-sentry-monitor
reasons: Criterion 2 warning: no public source repository found, so maintenance/activity cannot be verified.
Criterion 5 info: no egress declared, which is required before network behavior can be verified.
judgements.user_note: This plugin can remain listed in community, but it should not be marked verified until public source and egress declarations are provided.
